goal: SOTA BPC for autoregressive char-level text generation on enwik8 (target <= 1.05 BPC) and text8 (target <= 1.05 BPC).

current_best.notes: Iteration 8 (kernel v16) doubled context: block_size 256->512, token_local_window 64->128 at d1024/40ep. Clean 40/40 TPU run, val_bpc 2.2597 @ E40 — new best (+0.028 over iter-7). A parallel block_size=1024/tlw256 probe (mn2p267h) was WORSE (2.5418 BPC) — context 512 is the sweet spot for this capacity, do not push 1024. Trajectory now flat E34->E40 (2.260), i.e. architecture/capacity-limited not epoch-limited. Progression: 3.493 -> 3.268 -> 3.011 -> 2.5909 (d768/E20) -> 2.3023 (d768/E40) -> 2.2878 (d1024/E40) -> 2.2597 (d1024, ctx512/E40).

historical_source.note: Provenance kept for the agent's startup context. Identifiers (kernel slug, W&B entity/project/sweep/run) are NOT committed publicly — they are supplied to the runtime via GitHub Actions env vars / repository variables (WANDB_ENTITY, WANDB_PROJECT, WANDB_SWEEP_ID) and Kaggle secrets. Treat these fields as opaque labels when reading this file in the public mirror.

sota_reference.note: SOTA targets here are ballpark recent transformer-class results; the canonical target is improving on the user's own current best BPC, then chasing published SOTA.

next_iteration_directions: Iter-9 (about to push): architecture is the next lever, not context/epochs. Val was flat E34->E40 (2.260), and ctx1024 was worse, so apply modded-nanogpt TPU-safe wins at block_size 512 / tlw 128 / d1024 / 40ep: (1) ReLU^2 MLP in all EncoderBlocks (relu_squared_ff=True, record 5, ~1-2% val-loss), (2) logit softcap=15 on the char head (record 18, stabilizes small-vocab CE). Target <2.2 BPC.
If ReLU^2+softcap helps, next cheap additions from modded-nanogpt: QK-norm on MHA, untied embed/head, gated value-skip from compressor to chunk-decoder output.

Muon optimizer (Newton-Schulz-5) on the PerPos chunk decoder 2D weights is the biggest potential lever (~1.5x sample efficiency) but is a larger TF/Keras port; schedule LR ~2-4x AdamW and cosine to 0.1 peak. Do after cheap arch wins are banked.
Re-enable the online W&B sweep over d_model/chunk_dec_layers/lr once the arch experiment is green (RUN_MODE=sweep_online_single_agent).
Add ModelCheckpoint every epoch + resume-on-restart so a TPU session timeout never loses progress.
Evaluate ALiBi for chunk-level attention (currently forced off in TF due to slow impl).
Add a true text8 evaluation path (alternative corpus to cross-validate generalization).
